summary: Create the GitHub event stream under Automation Decisions > Event Streams: type GitHub Event Stream, the credential you made, copy the generated URL, and turn off Forward events to rulebook activations so it starts disabled while you set up and test the GitHub webhook.
questions: How do I create a GitHub event stream in EDA?
Why does my event stream say 'This event stream is disabled'?
Where do I get the webhook URL for GitHub?
